newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks bulge to 3-year high - EIA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks bulge to 3-year high - EIA.

text.p: U.S. inventories of propane posted a 7.4 million barrel build last month to 47.5 million, the highest year-ago level for propane stocks since 1994, the Energy Information Administration Report showed.
The monthly report released late Wednesday said inventories rose in all major regions in June, with the Midwest up by 3.5 million to 20.5 million, or 27 percent above year-ago levels.
The main production hub of the Gulf Coast increased by 2.9 million to 21.5 million, or 13 pct above year-ago inventory levels. The East Coast posted a 800,000-barrel rise.

"If inventories continue to build at normal rates for the remainder of the stock building season, U.S. inventories may reach 60 million barrels by the start of the 1997-98 heating season, the highest pre-heating season level since 1994," the EIA report said.
Total inventories as of June 30, 1997, were at 47.5 million, 6.9 million barrels, or 17 pct, above year-ago levels.
The next report is to be released Aug. 6, 1997. -- Laney Salisbury, New Oil Desk, 1 212 859-1631 --
